title:

Benchmark knowledge evi
question:
What is the average attendance of meetings in 2020?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: meetings in 2020 refers to type = 'Meeting' where YEAR(event_date) = 2020; average = DIVIDE(COUNT(event_id), COUNT(DISTINCT event_name))

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.XCL_010) AS average_attendance
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_013 = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.XCL_012) = '2020';
